text.tspan: GAP-MW-016: Logical signal contracts remain nominal until signal identity, units, freshness, and conversion rules are baselined.
GAP-MW-017: System service discovery, authentication, and binding contracts remain technology-neutral and incomplete until physical interface selection.
GAP-MW-018: Ownership and failure-response semantics for safety-path protection remain open pending safety analysis and physical realization.
Logical responsibility for translating and exposing vehicle-signal access without selecting a signal schema or transport.
Logical responsibility for proxying diagnostic requests and responses across the middleware boundary.
Logical responsibility for coordinating application-visible lifecycle state with middleware lifecycle state.
Logical responsibility for forwarding service health and availability status.
Logical responsibility for coordinating integration updates without selecting an update mechanism.
Logical responsibility for service discovery, authentication boundary handling, and service binding.
Technology-neutral logical composition of the middleware integration responsibilities.
Reviewers need the logical system decomposition, logical element
responsibilities, and ownership boundaries to be visible.
Reviewers need the typed logical interfaces, exchanges, directions,
and delegation from the logical system boundary to internal elements.
Reviewers need every system function allocated to one or more logical
elements without implying a physical or software implementation.
